evals.name: apply-mr-patch
evals.prompt: Our paragraphs module needs the fix discussed in https://www.drupal.org/project/paragraphs/issues/3107684 — the maintainers pushed it as merge request 270. Apply it to this project as a patch, following our patch convention. Don't run composer yourself.
evals.expected_output: Downloads the MR diff to src/drupal/addons/patches/3107684_MR270.patch (valid diff content, not HTML), adds an entry under patches.drupal/paragraphs in composer.patches.json keyed '#3107684: <issue title>', and hands the composer step to the user.
assertions: Patch file exists at src/drupal/addons/patches/3107684_MR270.patch (no '#' in the filename)
Patch file content is a valid unified diff (contains 'diff --git'), not HTML or empty

composer.patches.json has a top-level 'patches' object, and the entry sits at patches.drupal/paragraphs keyed '#3107684: <title>' (issue number only, no MR suffix in the key) pointing at the vendored path
Pre-existing patch entries preserved inside the top-level 'patches' object
No composer command run; composer step handed to user

evals.name: apply-comment-patch
evals.prompt: There's a patch on https://www.drupal.org/project/paragraphs/issues/3270166 that fixes validation of collapsed nested paragraphs. Vendor it into this project per our patch convention. Don't run composer yourself.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the patch attachment to comment 6 from the full api-d7 comment list (sorted by creation date), downloads it to src/drupal/addons/patches/3270166_CM6.patch, and adds an entry under patches.drupal/paragraphs in composer.patches.json keyed '#3270166: <issue title>'.
assertions: Patch file exists at src/drupal/addons/patches/3270166_CM6.patch (no '#' in the filename; comment number counted from the full api-d7 comment list in creation order)
Patch file content matches the drupal.org attachment (valid unified diff)

composer.patches.json has a top-level 'patches' object, and the entry sits at patches.drupal/paragraphs keyed '#3270166: <title>' (issue number only, no CM suffix in the key) pointing at the vendored path
Pre-existing patch entries preserved inside the top-level 'patches' object
No composer command run; composer step handed to user

evals.name: missing-plugin-setup
evals.prompt: Apply https://git.drupalcode.org/project/paragraphs/-/merge_requests/270.diff as a patch to drupal/paragraphs in this project.
evals.expected_output: Detects that cweagans/composer-patches is not configured, sets up composer.json (require + extra.patches-file + allow-plugins), resolves issue 3107684 from the MR metadata, vendors the patch per convention, creates composer.patches.json with a top-level patches object, does NOT run composer, and lists the composer.json changes prominently in the report.
assertions: composer.json set up correctly: cweagans/composer-patches in require, extra.patches-file pointing at composer.patches.json, no inline extra.patches

Patch file exists at src/drupal/addons/patches/3107684_MR270.patch, with NID 3107684 taken from the MR metadata (source project issue/paragraphs-3107684 via the MR API or drupalorg mr:show), not guessed or taken from the title alone
Patch file is a valid unified diff
composer.patches.json created with a top-level 'patches' object containing patches.drupal/paragraphs keyed '#3107684: <title>' pointing at the vendored path
No composer command run; composer step and the composer.json changes reported to the user

evals.name: gitlab-work-item-mr
evals.prompt: The empty-text bug in our ai_context listing is tracked at https://git.drupalcode.org/project/ai_context/-/work_items/3586692 and merge request 380 fixes it. Vendor that fix into this project per our patch convention. Don't run composer yourself.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the issue as a GitLab work item, downloads the MR diff to src/drupal/addons/patches/ai_context-3586692_MR380.patch, adds an entry under patches.drupal/ai_context in composer.patches.json keyed 'ai_context#3586692: <work item title>', and hands the composer step to the user.
assertions: Patch file exists at src/drupal/addons/patches/ai_context-3586692_MR380.patch (GitLab form '<project>-<IID>_MR<mr-iid>', no '#' in the filename)
Patch file content is a valid unified diff (contains 'diff --git'), not HTML or empty

composer.patches.json has a top-level 'patches' object, and the entry sits at patches.drupal/ai_context keyed 'ai_context#3586692: <title>' (project-qualified reference, no MR suffix) pointing at the vendored path
Does not treat 3586692 as a drupal.org node: no '#3586692' key and no drupal.org issue URL for it
Pre-existing patch entries preserved inside the top-level 'patches' object
No composer command run; composer step handed to user
